fields.Participants: Records Mgr, Compliance, Legal, Tax Manager

workflows.name: Retention Schedule Maintenance by Record Class (BIR/SEC/DOLE/NPC)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager maintains retention schedule mapping each record class to…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate retention against current regulations" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document management system" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Premature destruction violates retention law; mitigated by policy-enforced retention
System Touchpoints: - Retention schedule master; policy enforcement engine

steps.activity: Records Manager maintains retention schedule mapping each record class to mandated retention: BIR accounting/tax 10 years, DOLE payroll 3–5+ years, SEC corporate permanent/specified, NPC per purpose
Compliance/Legal/Tax validate retention against current regulations; updates on regulatory change
IT configures retention policy in document management system; enforces automatic disposition hold until retention expires

workflows.name: Retention Clock Start, Pause & Event-Driven Extension

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager defines retention-clock start event per class" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "IT starts clock automatically at triggering event" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Records Manager monitors clocks reaching expiry" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Wrong clock start causes early/late destruction; mitigated by event-based start logic
System Touchpoints: - Retention-clock engine; hold/extension controls; disposition queue

steps.activity: Records Manager defines retention-clock start event per class (e.g., tax record starts at fiscal year-end; contract at termination)
IT starts clock automatically at triggering event; pauses on legal hold or audit; extends on regulatory change
Records Manager monitors clocks reaching expiry; queues for disposition review; prevents premature destruction

workflows.name: Legal Hold Issuance, Scope & Release Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Legal issues legal hold notice defining scope" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents hold lifecycle" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: hold suspension and custodian notice
Pain Points / Risks: - **Legal risk**: Destroying records under hold invites spoliation sanction; mitigated by hold suspension and custodian notice
System Touchpoints: - Legal-hold workflow; preservation hold; hold register

steps.activity: Legal issues legal hold notice defining scope (custodians, date range, keywords, record classes); communicates to custodians
Records Manager/IT applies hold in repository (suspends retention clock and disposition); preserves relevant records and metadata
Legal releases hold at matter closure; Records Manager resumes normal retention; documents hold lifecycle

workflows.name: Disposition Review, Approval & Secure Destruction Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager generates disposition queue" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates no business need for extension" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-issue of "issues Certificate of Destruction" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Premature/undocumented destruction; mitigated by review/approval and certificates
System Touchpoints: - Disposition queue; approval workflow; Certificate of Destruction repository

steps.activity: Records Manager generates disposition queue (records at retention expiry); reviews for legal hold or active audit before destruction
Department Owner/Compliance approves disposition; validates no business need for extension
Records Manager executes secure destruction (physical or digital); issues Certificate of Destruction; archives certificate

workflows.name: Physical Records Destruction (Shredding/Pulping) & Certificate of Destruction

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager inventories physical records for destruction" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "audit of disposition" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-494 (ensure controlled execution — Retention, Legal Hold & Secure Disposition (PA-88.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Security risk**: Improper destruction enables data leak; mitigated by NAID-certified vendor and witness

steps.activity: Records Manager inventories physical records for destruction; boxes and labels; schedules NAID-certified destruction vendor
Destruction vendor shreds/pulps on-site or off-site under witness; provides Certificate of Destruction with inventory
Records Manager archives Certificate of Destruction linked to record inventory; supports audit of disposition

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records for destruction" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents purge evidence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "Records Manager archives digital Certificate of Destruction" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-494 (ensure controlled execution — Retention, Legal Hold & Secure Disposition (PA-88.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Residual risk**: Records persisting in backups; mitigated by crypto-shredding and backup purge
System Touchpoints: - Crypto-shredding engine; backup management; destruction evidence

steps.activity: IT Security identifies digital records for destruction; removes from primary repository using crypto-shredding (destroy encryption key) or secure delete
IT Security purges backups containing destroyed records per backup-retention cycle; documents purge evidence
Records Manager archives digital Certificate of Destruction; validates irrecoverability; supports audit

workflows.name: Data Subject Erasure Requests & Retention Conflict Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates identity and request scope per Data Privacy Act" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Records Manager/DPO resolves conflict between erasure and retention mandate" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-communication of "communicates outcome to data subject" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-494 (ensure controlled execution — Retention, Legal Hold & Secure Disposition (PA-88.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy/compliance risk**: Erasing records under legal retention; mitigated by conflict-resolution process

steps.activity: DPO receives data-subject erasure request; validates identity and request scope per Data Privacy Act
Records Manager/DPO resolves conflict between erasure and retention mandate (e.g., BIR 10-year retention overrides erasure for tax records); documents basis
DPO executes erasure where permissible; communicates outcome to data subject; archives request and decision

fields.Trigger: Annual BCM review or insurance renewal

workflows.name: Records Insurance, Off-Site Vaulting & Disaster Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "Records Manager identifies vital records" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates coverage vs." (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "IT/BCM tests records recovery in DR exercise" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-494 (ensure controlled execution — Retention, Legal Hold & Secure Disposition (PA-88.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Continuity risk**: Loss of vital records disrupts operations and audit defense; mitigated by vaulting and DR
System Touchpoints: - Off-site vaulting; geo-redundant backup; DR test evidence

steps.activity: BCM/Records Manager identifies vital records (corporate, legal, tax, title); establishes off-site vaulting and digital geo-redundant backup
Risk Manager structures records insurance for physical vital records; validates coverage vs. replacement cost
IT/BCM tests records recovery in DR exercise; validates RTO/RPO for document repository
